REELINTEL Account deletion

Delete your account

App: ReelIntel (com.reelintel.app)

You can delete your ReelIntel account yourself, from inside the app, and it takes effect immediately. You do not need to ask us, and you do not need to wait.

In the app

  • Open ReelIntel and tap the gear in the top right to open Settings.
  • The Account card is at the top.
  • Tap Delete account, then confirm.

Your sign-in, your catch log, your photos and your personal records are removed from our servers at that point, and the copy held on your phone is cleared with them.

By email

If you cannot sign in — a lost password, a phone you no longer have — email support@reelintel.ai from the address you signed up with and ask for your account to be deleted. We action it within 30 days, and in practice within a few days.

What is deleted

  • Your account and email address.
  • Your catch log: species, sizes, dates, notes and positions.
  • Your catch photos.
  • Your personal records and saved fishing spots.

What is kept, and for how long

Nothing that identifies you. Crash reports carry no account identifier and are kept for 90 days. Anything already counted into an aggregate — "how many anglers used the app this week" — cannot be traced back to a person and is not recoverable from it.

Questions: support@reelintel.ai
